issue.title: bob pomodoro shows a 'starts in Nm' lead-time state for sessions whose span has not started

task_type_fields.proposal:
While today's open timed Pomodoro has not started yet (its span starts after now), `bob pomodoro` should say so instead of counting down to the session's end. Today `src/native/pomodoro.rs` (the `[<{minutes_until_due}m]` branch after `now_minus_end`) prints `[<44m] FIX` at 09:42 for a 10:00-10:25 session, which reads as "44 minutes of work left". Proposed: a distinct lead-time state such as `[in 18m] FIX` (exact copy to be designed), driven by bob so the tmux status segment and the Bob Mac Capture menu-bar Pomodoro indicator (glossary: mac pom) render it without computing it themselves (decisions:mac-capture-is-a-thin-client). Say "in 18m" from the real wait, not the five-minute units typed (rounding makes `=+` at 09:42 an 8-minute wait).

The gap already exists for `=` typed at :02 (rounds up to :05) and for MEET starts that follow a future calendar run. It becomes routine once the planned `=+N` / `@route:id=+N` later-offset start syntax lands (research: research:202611/start_timing_later_offset/start_timing_later_offset.md, "Risks and follow-ups"), especially the `x =+` "close, take a five-minute break, start the next" idiom.
task_type_fields.why_out_of_scope: The later-offset epic changes capture grammar and start timing only; the status display is a separate surface (bob pomodoro, tmux, Mac menu bar) whose gap predates the feature, so the research recommended filing it as its own task rather than putting it on the epic's critical path.

issue.creation_reason: The +N later-offset start research recommended tracking this pre-existing status-line gap separately; later starts make future sessions routine.
